status: PRE-REGISTERED (committed before invites) — proposed Stage-0 bars, pending Operator ratification (D25)
rule: S54 — concrete + numeric + continue/pivot/stop; immutable-once-committed (a later edit is a conscious, disclosed re-pin via commitHash, never silent). The anti-overfitting discipline the Stamp applies to strategies, applied to the tool's own thesis.
window: the closed-alpha window: 14 days from the first invite accepted
cohort: the invited testers (Stage-0 demand kill-test; target invite list ~10)

metrics.question: did the tool earn a second session? (demand, not curiosity)
metrics.measurement: distinct testers with >= 2 sessions in the window (opt-in telemetry returning-count + Operator-confirmed; a tester who opted out counts as no-signal, never as a success)

metrics.question: did the people who used it TRUST the verdicts?
metrics.measurement: fraction of submitted /feedback entries with trusted=true (local, scrubbed, shared-on-consent)

metrics.question: did the credibility artifact (the Stream/Elixir/Resolv re-scores) open a real conversation?
metrics.measurement: count of design-partner / paid-interest conversations the re-score post-mortems directly opened (Operator-logged)

decisionRule: CONTINUE if >= 2 of the 3 metrics hit their continueThreshold and none hits its stopThreshold; STOP if >= 2 metrics hit their stopThreshold; otherwise PIVOT (the signal is weak but not dead — narrow the wedge). Graded ONCE at the window's end against THIS committed definition.
antiGoalpostMove: this file is committed to the ledger before any invite. The commitHash below is pinned in the BUILDLOG-PROBE final marker; changing any threshold after an invite goes out changes the hash and MUST be surfaced as a disclosed re-pin (an amendment with its reason), never a silent edit — the probe cannot be graded on a moved goalpost.
parkedOnResult: the LLM proposer / reports-API / execution / archive-node / calibration-scoring / new-Stamp-statistics unpark on EVIDENCE from this probe, not hope — which one unparks next is the probe's answer to give, not this sprint's.
